newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes four Burmese for drug trafficking.
newsitem.headline: China executes four Burmese for drug trafficking.

text.p: Authorities in China's southwestern Yunnan province on Friday executed four Burmese citizens for drug trafficking, the Xinhua news agency said.

The four, identified as Hui Xuehua, Zhang Yinfu, Chen Jiaxi and Lu Xiaofa, were all ethnic Chinese and were executed after being found guilty of entering Yunnan with nearly 38 kg (lb) of heroin in early 1993, the official agency said.
Hui and Zhang had been armed with a handgun and a grenade and had wounded a Chinese policeman, it said but gave no further details of the case.
